newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev keeps weakening of interest rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev keeps weakening of interest rate cut.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev continued weakening on Friday due to a cut in the main interest rate that becomes effective on Monday, sinking to 1,565-1,570 per dollar at 1300 local time (0900 GMT), dealers said.

The lev opened at 1,543-1,545, down from 1,534-1,536 at Thursday's close after the central bank said on Thursday it would lower its main interest rate to 4.29 percent monthly from 5.20 percent, in force from Monday.
"Shortcovering continues irrespecive of the price and we might see the lev falling to 1,600 by the end of the day," a bank dealer said.
Dollar supply was low as potential sellers expected the lev to ease further, traders said.

High lev liquidity was also putting pressure on the national currency after the Finance ministry rejected nearly half of 163 billion lev worth of bids for T-bills received at four auctions in the past two days. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
